items.quote: All API requests go through Xero's OAuth2.0 gateway and require a valid `access_token` to be set on the `client` which appends the `access_token` [JWT](https://jwt.io/) to the header of each request.
items.why: Says OAuth2 gateway and access_token needed; no PKCE, grant types, or 'no API keys'.

items.quote: A custom connection uses OAuth2.0's [`client_credentials`](https://www.oauth.com/oauth2-servers/access-tokens/client-credentials/) grant which eliminates the step of exchanging the temporary code for a token set.
items.why: States client_credentials grant only; doesn't establish oauth2 as sole method or the other grants.

items.quote: App pricing is a flat monthly fee based on plan and includes a set allotment of data consumption via the Xero APIs.
items.why: Pricing sentence about flat monthly fee; says nothing about free self-serve registration.
Connection limits per tier shown; no free tier or self-serve registration stated.

items.quote: The XPM API allows third-party apps and developers to programmatically connect to and interact with the data and functionality within a Xero Practice Manager account.
items.why: Describes XPM API only; supports one family, not REST breadth overall.

items.quote: This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Xero.
items.why: States it is an MCP server for Xero; vendor-official status not in quote.
